subject: Security questionnaire hotwash & prefill — clarifying scope and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security questionnaire hotwash & prefill — clarifying scope and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- What we covered: product architecture (API-only inference, optional VPC/private deployment), data handling (no user PII persisted by default, optional logging), compliance posture (SOC 2 in progress; we operate in AWS regions in US/EU).
- Key asks from Meditech: SOC 2 status and report cadence, whether Redwood supports HIPAA workloads (BAA), GDPR data residency controls, and an initial vendor questionnaire (SIG prefilling preferred).

Action items I captured: 
1) I’ll attach a prefilled SIG matrix with our answers for the items we discussed — this should cover the bulk of questionnaire fields and speed your internal review. (Attached: SIG-prefill-v1.xlsx)
2) Ben to provide short technical clarifications on data flows and encryption.
3) Marissa to share SOC 2 timeline and the scope of evidence we can provide.
4) Elena / security@meditech.co to confirm which questionnaire variant you prefer (full SIG, CAIQ subset, or your custom doc) and name of the person who will own completion/questions.

Estimated timeline: if we get confirmation on scope by EOD Wed, we can return a completed prefill + evidence list by next Tue (2026-09-22). Please let me know if you need a different cadence.

Attachments: [Attachment: SIG-prefill-v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, ~150KB)], [Attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (PDF, summary, 220KB)]

Thanks — Sean

--

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@meditech.co>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@meditech.co
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 13:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire hotwash & prefill — clarifying scope and next steps

Thanks Sean — helpful summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before we confirm scope: 

1) SOC 2: is your SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter) expected to be available before 2026-10-15? We need a current report within the last 12 months for our procurement timeline.
2) HIPAA / BAA: you mentioned optional BAA support — can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA for dedicated/private deployments (not for community hosted API) and whether PHI is ever written to long-term logs by default?
3) Data residency: for EU-based patient data we’ll need processing to be pinned to eu-west-1 — does your Private offering support that, or would we need to deploy in our own VPC/on-prem?
4) Questionnaire format: we prefer a SIG Lite to start; if the prefill covers all standard controls we can escalate to the full SIG as needed. Can you prefill for SIG Lite first?

Also please loop in the technical contact who can answer more detailed encryption/key-management questions.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Director, Security & Compliance
Meditech Solutions
elena.rossi@meditech.co
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@meditech.co>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire hotwash & prefill — clarifying scope and next steps

Hi Elena — Ben here (platform infra). Quick answers to the technical bullets Elena listed: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed its most recent Type II audit in Q2 2026; we can provide the report summary now and the full report under NDA. The SOC2-summary-2025.pdf attached has high-level coverage; the latest Type II report will be available by Oct 5, 2026 and we can provide a bridge letter if you need earlier attestation.

- BAA / PHI: We do offer BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Redwood hosted shared API (multi-tenant) we cannot sign a BAA. PHI is not persisted to long-term logs by default; we treat logs as ephemeral and redact PII for hosted tenants unless explicitly enabled by the customer. Detailed logging/evidence can be limited in Private deployments per contract.

- Data residency: Our Private deployment supports pinning processing to an EU region (eu-west-1) — we can run within your VPC or our Private offering in that region. For strict on-prem requirements we also have an appliance-based option but that has longer lead times.

- SIG Lite prefill: happy to prefill the SIG Lite sheet. I’ll mark any items that require evidence upload or that need engineering sign-off. 

If you can confirm the primary security contact and whether SIG Lite is acceptable, I’ll start annotating the prefill and capture the exact KMS/HSM options for the evidence matrix.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference.com

Perfect — thank you for the quick turnaround and the clarifications, Elena / Ben. Confirming next steps and timeline: 

1) Scope: Meditech confirms SIG Lite is preferred to start.
2) Deliverables from Redwood: 
   - Updated SIG Lite prefill (attached) with Ben’s annotations and an evidence checklist.
   - SOC2 Type II summary now; full report avail under NDA by Oct 5; we will provide a bridge letter if you need attestation earlier.
   - Statement on BAA applicability (we will draft standard BAA language for Dedicated/Private).

3) Owners & deadlines: 
   - Meditech security owner: Elena Rossi (security@meditech.co) to confirm SIG Lite collaborators by EOD 2026-09-17.
   - Redwood owner: Ben to complete SIG Lite prefill annotations and return updated file by 2026-09-21.
   - Redwood compliance: Marissa to initiate NDA/secure share for full SOC2 report by 2026-09-20 if requested.

4) Shared links/attachments: I’ve uploaded the current prefill and evidence list to the secure drive (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3csecure) and reattached the files here. Please confirm if we should proceed on the NDA route for the full SOC2 report.

If that plan looks good I’ll mark the HubSpot deal and set reminders. Thanks again — Sean
